title: NASA's Europa Clipper Spacecraft Heads Toward Jupiter's Ocean Moon
author: NASA Media Operations
summary: NASA's Europa Clipper has embarked on its long journey to Jupiter's icy moon Europa. The spacecraft will investigate whether Europa has conditions below its icy crust that could support life.

title: James Webb Space Telescope Identifies Coldest Interstellar Ice Yet Observed
author: Space Telescope Science Institute
summary: Using its sensitive infrared spectrographs, NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has probed the dark molecular cloud Chameleon I, inventorying frozen molecules essential for prebiotic chemistry.

title: NASA's Perseverance Rover Analyzes Enigmatic 'Cheyava Falls' Rock on Mars
author: Jet Propulsion Laboratory
summary: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover has discovered an arrow-shaped rock containing leopard-like spots and chemical signatures that may point to ancient microscopic life on the Red Planet billions of years ago.

title: Hubble Captures Spectacular Stellar Fireworks in Spiral Galaxy NGC 4423
author: Goddard Space Flight Center
summary: The NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope viewed galaxy NGC 4423 edge-on from a distance of 55 million light-years in the constellation Virgo, displaying brilliant dust lanes and active star-forming regions.

title: SpaceX Starship Flight 5 Successfully Catches Super Heavy Booster at Launch Pad
author: Aerospace Reporting
summary: In an unprecedented aerospace engineering milestone, the Super Heavy booster completed a controlled return to Starbase and was captured mid-air by the launch tower's mechanical arms ('chopsticks').

title: NASA's Roman Space Telescope Coronagraph Instrument Delivered to Goddard
author: NASA GSFC
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will carry an ultra-advanced starlight suppression coronagraph, capable of directly imaging giant exoplanets by blocking the blinding glare of their host stars by a factor of 100 million.
